page_title: FRE 2-2 EIN | Freiburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the left post. He did everything right but score!
90+2' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 2 Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes a brilliant free kick and curls the ball inside the right post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
87' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
86' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
83' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' Here's the change. Johan Manzambi leaves the pitch and Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
80' Here comes a substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Jonathan Burkardt.
80' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Hugo Larsson will be replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
75' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) replaces Derry Scherhant.
75' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Jordy Makengo is replaced by Christian Gunter (Freiburg).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ritsu Doan departs the field of play to be replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
72' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

69' Eintracht Frankfurt slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
65' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Can Yilmaz Uzun.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fares Chaibi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt).
64' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
64' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) replacing Lucas Holer.
64' A substitution has been made. Junior Adamu is replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
63' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
62' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
61' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
60' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
57' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
54' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kaua Santos makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
53' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
49' Deniz Aytekin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
48' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Deniz Aytekin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' The shots on goal statistics – 3:3.

41' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Kaua Santos keeps it out.
38' 1 - 2 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:2.

36' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
33' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
32' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle as Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt).
27' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
25' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in his challenge.
23' Wonderful movement by Eintracht Frankfurt. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
12' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle after Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
11' What a chance that is! Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
9' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' Great touch by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
6' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
5' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

2' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will referee today's match.
